lessons: Section 30A(c) has NO time window. A prior cycle invented a six-month existing-customer grace period; it is not in the statute. Re-check any future wording implying consent expires.

Hebcal has NO single flag or subcat meaning 'Israeli day off'. Confirmed by enumerating the full 2026 feed on 2026-08-19: subcat 'major' also carries all nine Chanukah days and all ten Chol HaMoed days (working days); mf=on adds five fasts of which four are working days; mod=on mixes Yom HaZikaron and Yom HaAtzma'ut with six working days; nx=on adds roshchodesh with no subcat. The shipped query is an allowlist minus a Chanukah/CH''M title exclusion, yielding 20 blocking dates for 2026. Two successive review rounds this cycle each caught a different wrong version of this filter. ENUMERATE the feed on any future edit; do not reason from the docs.
